Hi team — quick warm pass for Orbitics (deal D-2027-0583). Short summary and asks below.

Deal snapshot:
- Customer: Orbitics Labs (early-stage AI drug-discovery platform)
- Commitment: Redwood Dedicated (2x A100 equivalent reserved capacity) + 6 months Optimize engagement
- Target start: Week of 2027-06-21 (customer asked for 06/21 go-live window)
- Key success metrics: API latency <120ms p95, 100k tokens/day sustained within reserved capacity, model output stability for 3 canonical prompts

Attachments: Orbitics_SOW_v0.9.pdf (SOW draft), orbitics_network_requirements.xlsx (network/VPC checklist) — both attached to this email.

Outstanding items (sales => CS/Implementation):
1) Confirm primary CSM and technical steward.
2) Validate staging environment access (customer will provide staging API key and three test accounts).
3) Security/compliance: customer requests SOC2 evidence and encryption-at-rest details. They also flagged KMS integration for production keys.
4) Integration notes: they will call Redwood via our streaming text-generation API; they expect function-calling to orchestrate routing to internal workflows.
5) Procurement: DocuSign envelope in progress; procurement contact copied on follow-up below.

Customer POC: Maya Chen (maya.chen@orbitics.io) — engineering lead. Procurement: procure@orbitics.io.

Asks to CS: can someone pick up primary CSM for Orbitics? Prefer an owner who can lead a Week 0 runbook and a pre-flight with infra (network/VPC) by 06/18. I will remain engaged through go-live.

Thanks —

All — thanks for the quick replies. Finalizing owners and next steps here so CS has a single source of truth.

Owner matrix:
- Primary CSM: Monica Patel (monica.patel@redwood.ai) — responsible for customer cadence, acceptance criteria, and weekly success metrics.
- Technical Steward (Redwood Infra): Marissa Cole — responsible for VPC peering, subnet walkthrough, and infra escalations.
- Sales Sponsor: Karthik Iyer — remains in thread until sign + first two weeks of onboarding.
- Customer engineering lead: Maya Chen (maya.chen@orbitics.io) — staging keys and sandbox dataset owner.

Week 0 runbook (attached: week0_runbook.md) — high-level tasks and deadlines:
- 06/15: Customer provides staging API key + canonical prompts (Maya).
- 06/17: Technical pre-flight (Redwood Infra + Orbitics eng) — agenda: VPC peering, bandwidth profile, API auth, KV cache expectations. Link to meeting invite (calendar).
- 06/18–06/20: CS validation window (Monica) — run stability checks against canonical prompts, log regressions, and record token consumption.
- 06/21: Soft go-live window if all checks pass.

Open risks and mitigations:
1) Procurement delay: DocuSign expected 06/14. If not signed by 06/16, we'll shift pre-flight to 06/19.
2) Network constraints: Orbitics uses strict outbound firewall rules — Marissa to run a short checklist with Orbitics infra to validate allowed CIDR ranges (see orbitics_network_requirements.xlsx).
3) Security gaps: Partial questionnaire flagged a KMS key rotation policy question — Security Ops will review once full questionnaire is uploaded.

Action items:
- Karthik: confirm DocuSign sign date and nudge procurement if needed.
- Maya: confirm staging keys + test accounts by 06/15.
- Marissa: run VPC checklist and confirm allowable CIDR by 06/16.
- Monica: prepare Week 0 test plan and post acceptance criteria to HubSpot by 06/16.

I'll circulate the Week 0 calendar invite after Marissa confirms infra availability. If anyone needs to change ownership, respond here within 24h.

Thanks —
